name: B10-0214/2026 (The Left) – New Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the new Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
part_text:
The European Parliament is raising concerns about a new Chinese law on "ethnic unity and progress," which takes effect on 1 July 2026. The Parliament says the law could weaken the cultures, languages and religions of ethnic minorities in China. It asks China to make the law fully respect international human rights standards and to protect minority rights. It also calls on European Union member states to protect regional and minority languages at home. This is an opinion; the text does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks China to change its law and asks EU states to protect minority languages.
- **Who it affects:** Ethnic minorities in China, and people who speak regional or minority languages in the EU.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions, member states, and China's government and parliament.
